description:
Custom geometry is a no-cost option - and everyone wants a custom tandem!
Brushed Finish (not bead blasted)
Machined Titanium Head Tube and Eccentric Bottom Bracket shell (includes insert)
Head tube designed for 1-1/8" forks
Welded 7cm Titanium Insert in top of Seat Tubes (strengthens frame and allows 27.2mm seat post in an oversize seat tube)
7mm (1/4") Water cut titanium dropouts
Slotted, Welded Titanium Cable Guides
Welded Titanium Seat Post Binders
Six Welded Water Bottle Lugs (no rivet to loosen)
Fender / Rack Mounting Bosses
Down-tube mounted "STI cable stops"
Designed for mini-V brakes (or, can be designed around the brake of your choice)
"No Noodle" design - frame flex stops here!
All frames are fully hand-prepped prior to shipment or building
5-year warranty against defects in material and workmanship

components.description: Top Tube: 28x36mm oval; Lateral and Down Tube: 36x42mm teardrop; Boom Tube: 32x48mm oval; Seat Tube: 32mm OD; Seat Stay: 22mm round S-bend; Chain Stay: 22mm round S-bend
